title: Why voltage at scale is key in powering the AI revolution - SiliconANGLE
summary: The AI industry's shift to 800V power architecture to support high-density power delivery and reduce material waste is critical for sustaining the projected growth in data center power draw. Texas Instruments is expanding its U.S. manufacturing footprint to secure the supply chain for these critical power nodes, ensuring the transition towards renewable and nuclear energy sources is sustainable.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses a positive development in the AI industry with the adoption of 800V power architecture to address energy demands and sustainability, along with strategic investments in manufacturing.
